# MCP tool reference

The 1 tools the server offers, read from a running server.

The local service offers the same operations through its CLI and over stdio.

This server identifies itself as `events`. Read each tool's input schema before calling it.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`events_status`](#events_status) | Reports whether the local event service has an owner. |

### `events_status`

Reports whether the local event service has an owner.

*read-only · idempotent*

Takes no arguments.
